item.title: Texas Tech pauses business travel to the Middle East
item.description: Texas Tech University announced on Saturday that the university is temporarily pausing all business travel in the Middle East due to current security alerts issued by the U.S. Department of State.

item.title: Shallowater head basketball coach hospitalized after crash
item.description: According to a press release from Shallowater ISD, head boy's basketball coach Jay Lusk and his family were involved in a vehicle accident during their trip back from San Antonio on Friday.

item.title: Red Raiders fall to BYU, claim 4-seed in Big 12 Tournament
item.description: No. 10 Texas Tech headed west to wrap up the regular season with a rematch against BYU. In a tightly contested contest, the Cougars got revenge on the Red Raiders 82-76 to hand them another loss ahead of the Big 12 Tournament. After touting a three-game win streak, Texas Tech dropped both of its final games this week.

item.title: Texas Tech tames Penn State in three-game sweep
item.description: Texas Tech baseball welcomed its next foe, Penn State to Rip Griffin Park this weekend in the midst of a lengthy homestand. The Red Raiders made quick work of the Nittany Lions, who couldn't match their high-powered offense in a three-game sweep.

item.title: Major crash in Clovis leaves two dead, car in flames
item.description: The Clovis Police Department's Major Crash Team is currently investigating a crash that happened early Sunday morning in Clovis, New Mexico that left two people deceased and a third with major injuries.

item.title: Multiple departments battle fire in South Lubbock
item.description: Lubbock County Sheriff's Office is responding alongside several local fire departments to a multi-structure fire in the 1200 block of 132nd Street.
